From the table:

Percentage change = (New Value - Old Value) / Old Value × 100%
= (27.1 - 26.4) / 26.4 × 100%
= 0.7 / 26.4 × 100%
= 0.026515... × 100%
= 2.6515...%

0.7 / 26.4 = 0.0265151515...
